Membership & billing

Existing members should use their current account for billing, cancellation and payment-method changes. Do not start a duplicate membership to solve an access problem.

Profile & account support

Send a support request

Use this for sign-in trouble, profile-access conflicts, stopping management when billing or published member content is involved, or another profile/account problem.

Do not send passwords, payment-card details, government ID numbers, medical information, legal-case details or other highly sensitive information.

Nothing has been submitted yet.

When support is required

Contact support if profile access is disputed, if you need to stop managing a profile that still has active membership or published member content, or if you cannot safely recover the correct account.

For security, support may ask for public evidence of your relationship to the profile. Do not email passwords, payment-card details, government IDs or other sensitive information.

Language and accessibility

Support may be requested in English or Spanish. Report an accessibility barrier at community@franklinnavigator.com.
